steps.title: Load brightness
steps.text: Choose a TIFF, NPY or NPZ intensity image. Pixel values determine relative brightness.

await.hint: Press Intensity image and choose your map.

steps.title: Assign detectors
steps.text: Add one lifetime map in ns per detector. All maps must match the intensity shape; their list order assigns the detector routing.

await.hint: Add at least one lifetime map.

steps.title: Simulate
steps.text: Expand Simulation to inspect acquisition settings. Generate runs in a background worker and reports completion below the controls.

steps.title: Inspect the answer
steps.text: Use Map to compare input brightness, each lifetime map and reconstructed photon counts. Zoom, pan and adjust the colormap without changing the data.

steps.title: Export photons
steps.text: Choose an output format and save. PTO embeds reconstructed intensity; NPZ saves photon arrays. The tool also writes an intensity TIFF.
